newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel, copper fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel, copper fall sharply.

text.p: Nickel prices fell sharply on Wednesday on reports of a world downtrend while copper suffered a fresh setback on sluggish industrial demand, dealers said.
Other base metals held steady in dull trade.

Ready nickel fell 500 rupees to 36,200 rupees per quintal on heavy selling following reports of sharp setback in the world market. Copper lost 50 rupees to 12,200 rupees per quintal on sluggish industrial buying. It was down 50 rupees on Tuesday.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal and lead at 4,450 rupees per quintal. Tin was steady at 34,200 rupees per quintal. -- Bombay Commoditiies +91-22-265 9000
